    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); mks=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            v=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop()
                if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]!=v: continue
                seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): stack.append((a+dr,b+dc))
            rs=[a for a,_ in comp]; cs=[b for _,b in comp]
            hgt=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; wid=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
            if len(comp)==hgt*wid and hgt<6 and not any(0<=a+dr<h and 0<=b+dc<w and g[a+dr][b+dc]==bg for a,b in comp for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):
                mks.append((comp,v,hgt,wid))
    return mks,bg
